name: Ethiopia Yirgacheffe
description: Renowned for its distinct floral aroma, bright citrus acidity, and light body, this coffee behaves almost like a fine jasmine tea.

name: Colombia Finca El Paraiso
description: An experimental anaerobic natural processing method gives this coffee an intensely fruity, creamy profile reminiscent of fresh summer berries.

name: Guatemala Huehuetenango
description: Protected from frost by hot winds from Mexico, this classic cup delivers a distinct crisp acidity paired with rich, buttery chocolate notes.

name: Kenya Nyeri AA
description: Grown in volcanic soils near Mt. Kenya, this AA lot boasts an explosive, complex phosphoric acidity and deep black fruit sweetness.

name: Sumatra Mandheling
description: Processed using a traditional wet-hulling method, this heavy-bodied profile yields an intensely herbaceous, spicy, and deeply complex cup.

name: Costa Rica Tarrazú
description: A exceptionally clean natural process bean noted for high fine acidity, satisfying medium body, and a comforting, honeyed finish.

name: Brazil Cerrado Mineiro
description: A classic, low-acid natural coffee exhibiting high sweetness, a velvety heavy body, and dominant notes of toasted nuts and chocolate.

name: Panama Esmeralda Geisha
description: One of the most prized varieties in the world, renowned for its distinct floral aroma, explosive stone fruit sweetness, and elegant body.

name: Rwanda Nyamasheke
description: Grown near Lake Kivu, this selection offers sweet black tea qualities coupled with a snappy, bright red berry flavor signature.

name: El Salvador Pacamara
description: The large Pacamara seed yields an uncommonly intense savoriness alongside deep stone fruit characteristics and herbal nuances.

name: Yemen Mocha Harazi
description: Cultivated on high altitude terraced mountainsides for centuries. Intensely rustic, wild, and heavy with winey fruit and ancient spice notes.

name: Peru Cajamarca
description: Produced by a fair-trade co-op, this exceptionally clean washed organic lot centers around comfortable tree fruit sweetness and a soft nutty profile.

name: Mexico Pluma Oaxaca
description: A light-to-medium bodied staple highlighting smooth balance, low fruit sharpness, and a crisp clean finish perfect for all-day brewing.

name: Ethiopia Guji Natural
description: A classic natural process profile displaying prominent blueberry aromas, thick syrupy sweetness, and a heavy floral body.

name: Honduras Marcala
description: An eco-friendly solar-dried natural coffee presenting structured dried fruit sugars, gentle body, and a clean caramel tail.
